excavator: The big excavator works in the sand.
大大的挖掘机在沙堆里干活呢。
Does the excavator work in the dirt?
挖掘机是在泥土里干活的吗？
What a big excavator on our street!
我们街上这台挖掘机好大呀！
exchange: We exchange cards on Valentine's Day.
我们在情人节那天互相交换卡片。
Can we exchange baseball cards at school?
在学校我们可以交换棒球卡吗？
excitement: I feel excitement at the school gate.
站在学校门口，我心里特别兴奋。
Can you feel the excitement in the classroom?
你能感觉到教室里的兴奋劲儿吗？
So much excitement when the bus comes!
校车一来，大家兴奋得不得了！
excuse: Excuse me, please let me sit down.
不好意思，请让我坐下好吗。
His excuse made us all laugh.
他的借口把我们都逗笑了。
What is your excuse this time?
你这次又是什么理由呀？
exist: So many animals exist in the rainforest!
雨林里住着好多好多动物！
experiment: We do a fun experiment in the classroom.
我们在教室里做了一个好玩的实验。
Can I try the experiment with you?
我可以和你一起做这个实验吗？
What a big experiment with water and sand!
这个用水和沙子做的实验可真大呀！
expert: My mother is an expert on birds.
我妈妈是研究鸟类的专家。
Who is the expert on dinosaurs here?
我们这儿谁是恐龙专家呀？
He is an expert at soccer!
他踢足球可厉害了，是个高手！
explorer: The explorer walks far into the jungle.
探险家一直往丛林深处走去。
Does the explorer find a wide new river?
探险家找到一条宽宽的新河了吗？
Be an explorer in your backyard!
在自家后院当一回探险家吧！
extinct: Dinosaurs have been extinct for a long time.
恐龙灭绝已经很久很久了。
Why are the dinosaurs extinct now?
为什么恐龙现在灭绝了呢？
That big bird looks like an extinct animal!
那只大鸟看起来像灭绝的动物！
extreme: Jumping off the high rock is too extreme!
从高高的岩石上往下跳太冒险啦！
Is that game too extreme for little kids?
那个游戏对小娃娃来说是不是太猛啦？
How extreme the waves are today!
今天的海浪真是太夸张啦！
factory: The candy factory is near our school.
糖果厂就在我们学校附近。
What do they make in that factory?
他们在那家工厂里做什么呀？
The toy factory makes little red boats!
玩具工厂做出了小红船！
faint: I hear a faint noise at night.
夜里我听到一点很轻很轻的声音。
Can you see the faint light in the sky?
你能看见天上那道微弱的光吗？
What faint music from the old house!
老房子里传出的音乐好轻好轻呀！
fastball: The fastball goes right into my glove.
快球正好飞进我的手套里。
Is that a fastball or a slow ball?
Wow, his fastball is so fast!
哇，他的快球速度好快呀！
ferret: The ferret sleeps in a warm blanket.
雪貂睡在暖和的毯子里。
Can a ferret be a good friend?
The ferret has a long, thin body!
fess: 快老实交代，我的饼干哪去了！
I must fess up about the mud.
关于那滩泥，我得老实交代。
Will he fess up to mother?
他会向妈妈老实交代吗？
fierce: That little fish looks very fierce.
那条小鱼看起来可凶了。
How fierce the crocodile looks today!
今天这只鳄鱼看起来好凶呀！
fiesta: Our family dances at the fiesta.
What food do you eat at the fiesta?
在庆典上你们吃什么好吃的呀？
What a colorful fiesta in the park today!
今天公园里的庆典五颜六色，真热闹！
film: We watched a film about dinosaurs yesterday.
我们昨天看了一部关于恐龙的电影。
Which film do you want to see today?
你今天想看哪部电影呀？
That film about the little robot made me cry!
那部讲小机器人的电影把我都看哭了！
firecracker: The red firecracker makes a big noise.
红鞭炮会发出好大的声音。
Did you hear the firecracker outside?
你听到外面的鞭炮声了吗？
Never play with firecrackers near the house!
千万别在房子附近玩鞭炮！
firework: The firework opens like a big red flower.
烟花绽开，像一朵大大的红花。
Did you see the fireworks over the water?
你看见水面上的烟花了吗？
Wow, the fireworks light up the night sky!
哇，烟花把夜空都照亮啦！
flicker: Watch the candle flicker at night.
看蜡烛在夜里一闪一闪的。
Why does the screen flicker sometimes?
屏幕怎么有时候会一闪一闪的呀？
The lights flicker when the train goes by.
火车开过的时候，灯一闪一闪的。
floss: Use floss every night to keep your smile clean.
每天晚上用牙线，笑容才干净漂亮。
Do you use floss every day?
The little box of floss sits by the sink.
小小的牙线盒就放在水池边。
flow: The water flows from the hose into the bucket.
Watch the paint flow on the wet paper!
看颜料在湿纸上慢慢流开！
fluid: Water is a fluid that all animals need.
水是所有动物都需要的液体。
What other fluids do you know?
The red fluid looks like a fruit drink!
这种红色的液体看起来像果汁饮料！
flute: My sister plays a song on her flute.
我姐姐用长笛吹了一首曲子。
Can you play the flute for us?
The little flute has a very high voice!
小小的长笛声音好高呀！
flutter: The butterfly's wings flutter in the air.
蝴蝶的翅膀在空中扑扇扑扇的。
Why do the little birds flutter near the tree?
小鸟们为什么在树边扑腾呀？
Watch the yellow leaves flutter down!
看黄叶飘啊飘地落下来！
foolish: It was foolish to swim in the cold lake.
在冷冷的湖里游泳真是太傻了。
Was that a foolish thing to do?
Do not be foolish near the fast cars!
在飞驰的汽车旁边可别犯傻！
force: It takes force to open the old door.
打开这扇旧门得费点力气。
How much force does this game need?
玩这个游戏要用多大力气呀？
What force the little mouse has!
小老鼠的力气可真大呀！
forlorn: The little dog looks forlorn in the rain.
小狗淋在雨里，看起来好可怜。
Why does the old boat look so forlorn?
那条旧小船为什么看起来孤零零的呀？
Do not look so forlorn, little one!
小家伙，别这么垂头丧气的！
foul: That was a foul in the basketball game.
篮球比赛里那是一个犯规。
Why is that a foul in soccer?
踢足球时那为什么算犯规呀？
fountain: Water goes high up from the fountain.
水从喷泉里高高地喷出来。
Can we play near the fountain in the park?
我们可以在公园的喷泉旁边玩吗？
What a big fountain in our city!
我们城市的喷泉好大呀！
freak: Do not freak out about the little mouse.
看到小老鼠别吓得慌里慌张的。
Did you freak out at the big noise?
那声巨响有没有把你吓一跳？
He will freak out at the big spider!
看到大蜘蛛他一定会吓一大跳！
frontier: The family takes the wagon to the frontier.
一家人赶着马车去边疆。
What did people find at the frontier?
人们在边疆发现了什么呀？
Look at the map of the old frontier!
快看这张旧边疆的地图！
frozen: The lake is frozen in the cold winter.
寒冷的冬天，湖面结冰了。
Can we use our skates on the frozen pond?
我们可以在结冰的池塘上溜冰吗？
Look at the frozen frog in the ice!
快看冰里冻着的小青蛙！
fuel: The car needs fuel to go far.
汽车要加了燃料才能跑远路。
Where do we buy fuel for the truck?
我们去哪里给卡车买燃料呀？
Never play near fuel or fire!
千万别在燃料和火旁边玩！
fume: The old bus makes black fumes.
旧公交车冒出黑黑的烟气。
Why do trucks make so many fumes?
大卡车为什么冒出那么多烟呀？
Do not stand near the bad fumes!
别站在难闻的烟气旁边！
funnel: I put water in the bottle with a funnel.
我用漏斗把水灌进瓶子里。
The sand runs down the funnel fast!
沙子顺着漏斗飞快地往下漏！
fuss: The baby makes a big fuss at nap time.
到了午睡时间，小宝宝闹腾得厉害。
Why do you make a fuss about small things?
你干嘛为一点小事大惊小怪呀？
Do not fuss about a little dirt!
有一点脏而已，别大惊小怪的！
galaxy: Our galaxy is very, very big.
我们的星系非常非常大。
Can you see the galaxy at night?
Look at the big galaxy in this book!
快看这本书里大大的星系！
galoshes: I put on my galoshes when it rains.
下雨的时候我就穿上雨靴。
你的黄雨靴放到哪儿去了呀？
My galoshes keep my feet dry in the mud!
穿着雨靴，踩泥巴脚也不会湿！
gangway: We walk up the gangway onto the boat.
我们走过舷梯登上小船。
Is the gangway wet from the rain?
Do not run on the gangway of the boat!
别在船的舷梯上跑来跑去！
garage: Father puts the blue car in the garage.
爸爸把蓝色的小车停进车库。
Is your bike in the garage?
你的自行车在车库里吗？
The old garage has a big red door!
旧车库有一扇大大的红门！
gauge: My rain gauge sits in the garden.
我的雨量器立在花园里。
Where is the gauge on this car?
这辆车上的仪表在哪儿呀？
Oh no, the gauge says we must stop!
哎呀，仪表说我们必须停下来啦！
gear: 我的自行车上有三个齿轮。
How do you turn the gear?
The little gear turns round and round!
gem: She found a green gem in the sand.
她在沙子里找到一颗绿色的宝石。
Is this little red rock a gem?
这块小红石头是宝石吗？
The gem is blue like the sky!
这颗宝石蓝得像天空一样！
general: The general has a big white horse.
将军有一匹高大的白马。
How tall the general looks today!
将军今天看起来真高大呀！
generator: The generator makes light for the camp.
发电机让营地亮起了灯。
Why does the generator make that noise?
发电机为什么会发出那种声音呀？
The little generator keeps the lights on!
小小的发电机让灯一直亮着！
geometric: I paint geometric art at school.
我在学校画几何图案的画。
What geometric things can you find in the classroom?
你在教室里能找到哪些几何形状的东西呀？
My geometric blanket is so colorful!
我的几何图案毯子色彩真多呀！
gesture: A wave is a nice gesture.
挥挥手就是一个友好的手势。
那个手势是什么意思呀？
What a warm gesture from your friend!
你朋友这个手势真暖心呀！
gigantic: A gigantic whale swims in the ocean.
一头巨大的鲸鱼在大海里游。
Did you see that gigantic dinosaur?
你看见那只巨大的恐龙了吗？
What a gigantic pumpkin in our garden!
我们花园里的南瓜好巨大呀！
glacier: The glacier is a big river of ice.
冰川就是一条大大的冰河。
Where can we see a glacier?
我们去哪里能看到冰川呀？
Cold water runs from the old glacier!
冰凉的雪水从古老的冰川里流出来！
gladiator: The gladiator had a big helmet.
那个角斗士戴着一顶大大的头盔。
What did the gladiator eat for lunch?
角斗士午饭吃的是什么呀？
Read a story about a gladiator!
读一个关于角斗士的故事吧！
glance: One glance at the map helped us go home.
瞄了一眼地图，我们就找到回家的路了。
Did you get a glance at the baby owl?
你瞧见那只猫头鹰宝宝了吗？
Take a glance at my new book!
glare: Why does that cat glare at my dog?
那只猫为什么瞪着我的狗呀？
The sun's glare is hard on my eyes.
太阳刺得我眼睛都睁不开。
Put on your sunglasses to stop the glare!
戴上太阳镜，就不刺眼啦！
glob: A glob of green paint is on my shirt.
我衬衫上沾了一团绿颜料。
What is this big glob on my page?
我纸上这个大团团是什么呀？
Do not use a big glob of glue!
别一下挤一大坨胶水呀！
globe: The globe sits on my desk at home.
地球仪摆在我家的书桌上。
Can you find the big ocean on the globe?
你能在地球仪上找到大海洋吗？
Turn the globe round and round!
把地球仪转呀转起来吧！
glucose: Glucose is in fruit and milk.
水果和牛奶里都有葡萄糖。
What foods give your body glucose?
哪些食物能给身体补充葡萄糖呀？
Glucose helps your body run and play!
葡萄糖帮你跑跑跳跳有力气！
gosling: The yellow gosling walks near the lake.
黄黄的小鹅在湖边散步。
Did you see the little gosling swim?
How small the new gosling is!
government: The government helps keep the city park clean.
政府帮助大家保持城市公园干净整洁。
What does the government do for us?
政府为我们做了哪些事呀？
Wow, the government building is big and old!
哇，政府大楼又大又有年头！
grain: Birds eat the grain in the farmer's field.
小鸟在农夫的田里吃谷粒。
What grain do you eat for lunch?
你午饭吃了哪种谷物呀？
gravestone: The old gravestone sits under the big tree.
那块旧墓碑立在大树底下。
Please do not play near the gravestone.
请不要在墓碑附近玩耍。
greedy: The greedy dog wants all the cookies.
贪心的小狗想把所有饼干都要走。
Is it greedy to take them all?
把它们全拿走是不是太贪心啦？
Do not be greedy with the candy!
糖果可别一个人贪多呀！
grid: We draw a grid on the paper.
我们在纸上画了一个格子网。
Can you find your street on this grid?
你能在这张格网图上找到你的街道吗？
The map has a grid of thin lines!
地图上画着细细的格子线！
groom: The groom washes the big horse every day.
马夫每天都要给大马擦洗。
Where does the groom keep the horse's food?
马夫把马儿的口粮放在哪儿呀？
The groom walks the horse to the water!
gruff: The old goat has a gruff voice.
老山羊的声音粗声粗气的。
Why is he so gruff today?
他今天怎么这么凶巴巴呀？
Do not be gruff with your little sister!
guilty: I feel guilty about the mud on the rug.
地毯上踩了泥，我心里很过意不去。
Why do you look so guilty?
你怎么一副做错事的样子呀？
Say sorry when you feel guilty!
做错了心里过意不去，就要说对不起！
gulf: Our boat goes out into the big gulf.
我们的小船驶向大大的海湾。
What fish live in the warm gulf?
温暖的海湾里住着什么鱼呀？
How big the blue gulf looks today!
今天蓝色的海湾看起来好大呀！
gusty: The kite flies high on this gusty day.
这个刮大风的日子，风筝飞得好高。
Is it gusty outside right now?
What a gusty day at the beach!
今天海边的风可真大呀！
gutter: Rain water runs down the gutter.
Did you see the leaf in the gutter?
你看见排水沟里的树叶了吗？
Keep the leaves out of the gutter!
别让树叶掉进排水沟里！
habitat: The pond is a good habitat for frogs.
池塘是青蛙安家的好地方。
这个栖息地里住着谁呀？
A forest is a habitat for many animals!
森林是许多动物安家的地方！
handlebars: My bike has new black handlebars.
我的自行车装了新的黑色车把。
Are the handlebars too high or too low?
车把是太高了还是太低了呀？
Wow, the red handlebars look so cool!
哇，红色的车把看起来好酷呀！
haystack: A cat sits on the big haystack.
一只小猫坐在大干草堆上。
Can the cat jump over the haystack?
headquarters: Our team works at the big headquarters.
我们队伍就在大总部里工作。
你们队伍的总部在哪儿呀？
The headquarters building is very tall!
hearing: Does a dog have good hearing?
What fine hearing that little mouse has!
那只小老鼠的听力真灵呀！
heave: We heave the big box onto the truck.
我们用力把大箱子搬上卡车。
Can you heave the big bucket of water?
这么大一桶水，你抬得动吗？
Heave that rock up with me!
一起来使劲把那块石头抬起来！
herd: A herd of cows walks home at night.
夜里，一群奶牛走回家去。
Did you see the herd of sheep?
The farmer keeps a big herd of goats!
农夫养了好大一群山羊！
hero: 妈妈就是我心中的英雄。
Who is your hero in the story?
The pilot is a hero to all of us!
那位飞行员是我们大家心中的英雄！
heroic: That was a heroic thing to do.
Did you read the heroic story?
你读过那个英勇的故事吗？
The little dog was a heroic helper!
小狗狗当了一回英勇的小帮手！
heron: A tall white heron stands in the pond.
一只高高的白鹭站在池塘里。
What does the heron eat at the lake?
The heron flies up with slow, big wings!
白鹭扇着大大的翅膀，慢悠悠地飞起来！
hesitate: Do not hesitate to ask for help.
需要帮忙就开口，别犹豫。
Why did you hesitate at the high slide?
你在这么高的滑梯前犹豫什么呀？
She did not hesitate to help her friend.
她毫不犹豫地去帮助朋友。
highlands: The sheep live up in the highlands.
绵羊住在高高的山地上。
Is it cold in the highlands today?
We can see the green highlands from here!
从这里能看见绿绿的高地！
history: I love my history book about dinosaurs.
我喜欢我那本讲恐龙的历史书。
Why do you like history so much?
你为什么这么喜欢历史呀？
Old stories tell us about history!
hoist: Workers hoist the big sign up.
工人们把大牌子吊了上去。
Can you hoist this bucket up to me?
你能把这个水桶拉上来给我吗？
Hoist the box up, up, up!
把箱子往上拉，加油，再高点！
hola: Say hola to your friend today!
Did you say hola to the new kid?
你和新来的同学说Hola了吗？
Hola, my friend, let's play a game!
Hola，我的朋友，我们来玩游戏吧！
honor: It is an honor to help you.
能帮你的忙，我特别荣幸。
How do we honor our helpers at school?
在学校我们怎么向帮忙的人致敬呀？
What an honor for our little team!
对我们小队来说多光荣呀！
horrible: The rain made our picnic horrible.
这场雨把我们的野餐搞得一团糟。
Was the movie really that horrible?
那部电影真有那么糟糕吗？
What a horrible noise in the night!
hotel: Our hotel is near the beach.
我们的旅馆就在海边附近。
What number is our hotel room?
我们的旅馆房间是几号呀？
Wow, our hotel room has two big windows!
哇，我们的房间有两扇大窗户！
hurricane: In a hurricane, the rain comes down hard.
飓风来的时候，雨下得又急又猛。
飓风是什么时候停的呀？
Do not go outside in a hurricane!
刮飓风的时候千万别出门！
hydrant: The red hydrant sits by the sidewalk.
红红的消防栓立在人行道边。
Did you see the dog at the hydrant?
你看见消防栓旁边的小狗了吗？
Do not park the car by the hydrant!
别把车停在消防栓旁边！
incredible: The robot can do an incredible dance.
这个机器人会跳一支了不起的舞。
Did you see that incredible jump?
你看见那记不可思议的跳跃了吗？
What an incredible story about whales!
这个讲鲸鱼的故事太不可思议啦！
independence: Independence Day comes in the summer.
What do people do on Independence Day?
独立日这天大家都做些什么呀？
We have a big picnic on Independence Day!
独立日那天我们去野餐，好开心！
independent: My sister is very independent at school.
我姐姐在学校特别独立。
Is the little bird independent now?
小鸟现在能自己独立生活了吗？
Try to be independent at bath time!
洗澡的时候试着自己的事情自己做吧！
indigo: The sky turns indigo at night.
夜晚的天空变成靛蓝色。
Is indigo more blue or more purple?
靛蓝色是更偏蓝还是更偏紫呀？
Look at the indigo paint on the page!
快看纸上这块靛蓝色的颜料！
ingredient: An egg is one ingredient in these cookies.
鸡蛋是做这些饼干的原料之一。
What ingredient do we need now?
我们现在还需要哪种原料呀？
Every ingredient is on the table!
所有原料都摆在桌子上啦！
inject: My mother will inject it into my leg.
